test_title: PYST 75: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Some women have reached the ______. (peak) in their profession.
solution:
The correct answer is** "zenith."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Peak **is the highest point, degree, or volume; the point of highest intensity.
 
• Often used to refer to mountains, but can also describe highest points or maximums in abstract sense, such as performance or time.
 
 
• **Example: **"He climbed to the peak of Mount Everest."
 
 
 
• Zenith is used more generally to mean the very top or highest point of something.
 
 
• **Example: **"The sun was at its zenith."
 
 
 
• So in this context, **"zenith" **fits perfectly as it signifies the highest or most successful point in a professional career -- the **"peak."**

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finale: **This term generally refers to the last part of a piece of music, a performance, or public event, especially when particularly dramatic or exciting.
 
• **Sky: **Besides its common meaning as the expanse of air surrounding the earth, sky is sometimes used metaphorically to describe a limit or unlimited space.
 
• **Crossroads: **This term refers to a point at which a crucial decision must be made that will have far-reaching consequences.
